query:
INSERT INTO mail.dedupe (plugin_id, dedupe_key, user_id)
           SELECT $1, $2, u FROM UNNEST($3::uuid[]) AS u
           ON CONFLICT (plugin_id, dedupe_key, user_id) DO UPDATE SET at = now()
             WHERE mail.dedupe.at < now() - make_interval(days => $4)
           RETURNING user_id
